alt.en: Source states h1, h2, h3 still depend on their predecessors. With a known decoder query, three source comparisons can run together. Their context updates the decoder; only then can the next query be computed.
alt.zh-hans: 源状态 h1、h2、h3 仍依次依赖前一步。已知解码查询后，可以同时比较三个源状态；上下文用于更新解码器之后，才能得到下一个查询。

caption.en: Figure 14.2 — Parallel comparisons sit inside a sequential recurrent calculation.
caption.zh-hans: 图 14.2 — 比较可以并行，外层递归仍要依次计算。

credit.en: Original computed teaching diagram, CC BY-SA 4.0. Queries are supplied probes; source states are calculated from the declared encoder.
credit.zh-hans: 本书原创教学计算图，CC BY-SA 4.0。查询为给定探查值，源状态由声明的编码器计算。

flow.en: An early saved state has a direct route to the read, without passing through the remaining encoder updates.
flow.zh-hans: 较早保存的状态可以直接进入读取，不必再经过后面的编码更新。

flow.en: The three comparisons may run in parallel; they all require the current query first.
flow.zh-hans: 三次比较可以并行，但都要先拿到当前查询。

text.en: Old state + previous token + cₜ → sₜ
text.zh-hans: 旧状态 + 前一个 token + cₜ → sₜ

flow.en: Teacher forcing supplies tokens, not future hidden states. During generation, the next input token must also be selected.
flow.zh-hans: 教师强制提供 token，不提供未来隐藏状态；生成时还要先选出下一步输入 token。
